title: Borrowing from an Option
goal: Convert a borrowed Option<String> to Option<&str> without allocating or moving.
hints: Cloning inside endpoint_str creates a temporary Option that gets dropped before the reference can be returned.
Option has a built-in method that converts &Option<String> to Option<&str> using Deref.
explanation: `Option::as_deref` converts a reference to `Option<T>` into `Option<&T::Target>` using `Deref` coercion. This transforms `&Option<String>` into `Option<&str>` without allocating or moving. Calling `.clone().as_deref()` creates a temporary `String` whose borrow cannot outlive `endpoint_str`, triggering `E0515`. Calling `unwrap` tries to move the `String` out of a borrowed `Config`, triggering `E0507`. Passing `&cfg.clone()` borrows a temporary copy of `Config`, triggering `E0716` when `ep` is used later.
